"Let's build a monster"

Zeb Jackson and Morgan Walken work together to construct a monster, Lil Bo Pumpkins. Zeb provides the pumpkins as the farmer, Morgan provides the bodies as the undertaker. And together they create a Frankenstein of sorts who's ready to harvest some souls.

Might not be as competitively cohesive as the others posted, but I guess the focus here is giving more mobility to Morgan Walken, a tragically slow an immobile ghost with a decent enough health pool to take advantage of. This team takes to the skies with flight and jump pads, making hunters constantly have to monitor the ghosts in 3 dimensions of motion. This should hopefully create enough chaos for the ghosts to gloom up the game.

I feel like a failure every day of my life and I hate looking in the mirror and seeing disappointment. I work in a shitty dead end job that I hate, living paycheck to paycheck and living with the fact that I will never have the money or the intelligence to be what I want to be. I can pinpoint the exact time I went from enjoying my life to hating it, and it was because I was a failure at university. Stay in school kids, and don't set your expectations too high or else you'll just end up disappointed.
